digest:
- Selective Insurance is contesting coverage on a commercial crash involving an employee-owned vehicle missing from the policy, highlighting that hired-and-non-owned auto gaps and driver verification remain critical underwriting hurdles [1].
- Grange Insurance halved its commercial quoting time and classification calls for agents, increasing competition for broker-distributed business and reinforcing the need for digital MGAs to maintain ultra-fast quoting [9].
- Global electric commercial vehicle market projections highlight a $341 billion opportunity driven by last-mile demand, underscoring the need for telematics risk models tailored to electric cargo vans and box trucks [2].
- HCSS and Verizon Connect partnered to integrate fleet intelligence and automate data transfers, reflecting ongoing market expectations for seamless telematics and fleet management data integration in commercial auto [13].
- Legal commentary addressing NYC delivery e-bike liability, comparative negligence, and dooring reaffirms the complex urban liability and claims risks faced by delivery fleets operating e-bikes and urban couriers [3].
